claim_boundary.reason: P20 is a functional multi-token request-cycle qualification. The GPU cycle contract is not performance calibrated.

operator_types.notes: P20 qualifies the four-token request-cycle, versioned KV state, Global PA and one live Ramulator2. GPU compute remains an uncalibrated tiled cycle contract, not an Accel-Sim trace.
